row.title: Main writer caps 20 files per commit
row.body: The first live QUEUE-PERSIST-1 pass changed more than 20 queue item files; the main-writer Worker accepts at most 20 files per commit (HTTP 400) and the ruleset only admits commits through that Worker. Surfaces tested: Worker route (400), direct push (GH013). tools/push_main.py now sends consecutive commits of 20 and does not fall back once a part has landed; verified by tests/test_push_main_batches.py.
